crossRefs.note: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in…
Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them…
You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in…
All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have…
But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.’
No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.
He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots; as I also have received of my Father:
Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will…
But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

translations.web: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. Yahweh came down for me against the mighty.
translations.bsb: Then the survivors came down to the nobles; the people of the LORD came down to me against the mighty.
translations.kjv: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.
translations.asv: Then came down a remnant of the nobles and the people; Jehovah came down for me against the mighty.
